title: Time Fracture Resonance
problem: Any creature of the side at the bottom counts (text: THIS creature).
notes: In-game test: Time Fracture Resonance: compare the holder's spells/damage/healing/stat effects at the bottom of the Timeline vs anywhere else; bonus only at the bottom, and only for the holder. Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "While this creature is at the bottom of the Timeline". H: Time Fracture Resonance (all three calculators): require the holder itself at the bottom. vs bugged: weaker.

release_notes.intended: While this creature is at the bottom of the Timeline, your creatures' spells cost no charges, always crit and have 100% more potency.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it worked while any creature of the holder's side was at the bottom.
release_notes.fix: Now it only works while the holder itself is at the bottom of the Timeline.
